# Pine to Lake transfer

Take the Blue line from Pine toward Market. At Market, leave the Blue train and change to the Green line toward Lake. Lake is the third stop after Market on Green. Keep the same ticket for the second train; the route is one journey and does not require a new purchase.

## Finding the connection

Follow the Green line signs from the Blue arrival area into the transfer concourse. Departure boards there show Green trains toward Lake. Platform assignments are not included in this route sheet. Stay inside the ticket gates during the change. If you leave through the street exit, you have left the transfer route.

## Arrival

At Lake, use the Library exit for the reading room. The River exit is on the opposite side of the station. This route sheet gives no departure times or service frequency.
files.docs/transfer-guide.md:
# Travel from Pine to Lake

The trip has two train rides and one change. You stay on Green until Lake, then walk from the station to the reading room.

## Start at Pine

Take Blue from Pine toward Market. Your change is at Market, where Green takes you onward to Lake. Keep your ticket handy through the journey.

## Change at Market

Leave the Blue train and follow the Green signs. Buy a second ticket before boarding Green toward Lake. The departure platform will be shown on the boards.

## Reach the reading room

Get off at Lake. Both exits take you directly to the reading room.
files.sources/access.md:
# Reading room access

The Library exit has stairs. The River exit has step-free access and reaches the reading room by a signed five-minute path along the north side of the station. Both paths end at the same entrance. The route sheet describes the shortest walking route.

rubric.description: The first guide sends the traveler from Pine on Blue to Market, then on Green toward Lake, keeping the same ticket and staying inside the gates. Correct the draft's second-ticket error. Do not invent a platform before the source update.
After the update, add platform 4 for the Green departure at Market, preserving line order, destination, ticket and gate instructions. Keep these accepted facts in the final revision.

Correct the draft's arrival error: Lake is the third stop after Market and the Library exit serves the reading room; the River exit is on the opposite side. Preserve arrival advice through both followups and avoid invented schedules or frequency.

Every complete saved artifact reads as traveler instructions. Assess paraphrases as well as explicit statements.
